usa.title: SpaceX's Starship soars into orbit after booster malfunction thwarts double catch attempt

usa.title: FAA issues rare nationwide ground stop due to 'extraordinary circumstances'

usa.title: News Wrap: Tanker crashes into river cruise boat in New Orleans

usa.title: Bessent accuses Lutnick of failing to prevent China from obtaining Nvidia chips
usa.summary: The fallout of Jensen Huang's downfall expanded into a public fight between two of President Trump's top advisers. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent accused Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick of failing to prevent China from obtaining Nvidia's most advanced chips. Nick Schifrin looks at the finger-pointing and the ongoing efforts to control advanced technology exports to China.

usa.title: Increasing cost of housing squeezes Americans out of market
usa.summary: Sales of existing homes in the U.S. fell last month to their lowest level in more than 16 years. That's according to a new report by the National Association of Realtors. In October alone, sales dropped to 3.75 million homes, an 8.8% drop compared with the same time last year. Stephanie Sy reports on what's driving the decline.

usa.title: Does Van Hollen have enough support to beat Schumer in Senate leadership race?
usa.summary: Senate Democrats won back their majority last week, and now they're fighting over who will lead it. Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen has thrown his hat in the ring and says he will take on current Democratic leader Chuck Schumer. Congressional correspondent Lisa Desjardins reports on the first serious challenge Schumer has faced to his party leadership.

usa.title: ICE touts record number of deportations in agency's history
usa.summary: The Department of Homeland Security reports that immigrant deportations and arrests hit an all-time high. More than 491,000 people were arrested by ICE in the last fiscal year, and more than 483,000 were deported. The Trump administration has said it aims to deport one million immigrants annually. William Brangham discussed more with John Sandweg, who was acting ICE Director under President Obama.

usa.title: What to know about Microsoft's outage and why it takes so long to restore email services

usa.title: Celebrated countertenor brings classical sound to today's cultural issues

The leading international opera singer is performing in the Metropolitan Opera's critically acclaimed and wildly popular "Lincoln at the Bardo," which the Met will stream for free to the public on Saturday. Senior arts correspondent Jeffrey Brown has the story for our arts and culture series, CANVAS.
